contract: Magento / Adobe Commerce V1 Product Field Contract
applicability: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source 2.4.x Admin REST; installation-specific EAV metadata must be discovered from the target installation and attribute set.

rows.requiredness: required for create and repository save
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: POST /V1/products or PUT /V1/products/:sku; URL/body identity must agree
rows.platform_domain_owner: ProductVariant sellable identity; ExternalRecordLink external identity
rows.current_blocker: Receive proposal is name-only in AdobeProductReceiveProposalService; GovernedProductVariantColumnMutationService fail-closes sku; Safe Sync uses expected_sku solely as an identity precondition.

rows.requiredness: required by normal Magento product attribute configuration
rows.localization_semantics: store-view value; store code selects context
rows.current_blocker: Public Products/Export/Live support remains false pending target certification; Receive Apply is intentionally the narrow name-only governed column seam.

rows.scope: website / store semantics depend on attribute metadata
rows.product_type_applicability: simple and configurable; child visibility differs
rows.platform_domain_owner: Product Catalogue lifecycle and connector execution semantics
rows.platform_field_binding: status mapping; visibility is connector-owned semantic projection
rows.current_blocker: Receive proposal/apply only plans name. Safe Sync accepts status/visibility, but public live is gated false and no Receive candidates exist.

rows.frontend_input: text, textarea, texteditor, date, datetime, boolean, price, weight
rows.localization_semantics: store scope is localizable; website is scoped but not translation JSON
rows.option_semantics: boolean has platform values; other scalar types none
rows.installation_condition: Only attributes returned by the selected target installation/attribute set exist; apply_to and backend validation remain authoritative.
rows.current_blocker: Normalizer supports the listed frontend_input values but does not retain apply_to, backend_type, default_value, validation rules, or is_user_defined/system semantics. Receive and Safe Sync read expose name only; mapped writes accept only scalar strings.

rows.magento_field: legitimate non-service attribute frontend inputs outside current map
rows.frontend_input: weee and module-defined values outside the core interface may occur; ProductAttributeInterface exposes this as an unconstrained string
rows.option_semantics: type-specific; must be established from the installed module contract
rows.platform_domain_owner: Connector discovery normalization then Attribute Dictionary
rows.installation_condition: Present only when returned by the target installation; module-defined frontend_input values cannot be assumed globally.
rows.current_blocker: AdobePaaSAttributeNormalizer::mapFrontendInput throws UnmappedValue for every value outside its closed match; add explicit normalized semantics per verified value and fixture tests rather than a permissive fallback.

rows.localization_semantics: option labels may vary by store; persisted value is option id
rows.option_semantics: external option value/id must map to governed internal option key
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: custom_attributes value uses target option id
rows.installation_condition: Options are installation/store dependent and must come from the authoritative discovery snapshot.
rows.current_blocker: Normalizer captures options but not store-view label provenance; Receive read/proposal has no mapped attributes; Safe Sync mapped write is scalar string only; public live remains false.

rows.magento_api_datatype: comma-separated option ids in common REST product representation; metadata options list
rows.option_semantics: each internal option requires an external option mapping; order/serialization must be defined
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: custom_attributes serialized value per Magento backend contract
rows.installation_condition: Options and backend serialization are target dependent.
rows.current_blocker: Semantic planner mappedScalarValue rejects arrays and Safe Sync ProductWriteMappedAttributeInterface requires a single string without governed multi-option serialization; add multi-value projection/resolution and tests.

rows.localization_semantics: option labels may be store-view scoped
rows.option_semantics: child option ids and attribute ids, not labels
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: configurable option management endpoints and product extension attributes
rows.platform_domain_owner: Product/ProductVariant relation + mapped variant select fields
rows.platform_field_binding: variant-level select FieldBindings plus connector execution operations
rows.installation_condition: Dimension attributes must belong to selected attribute set and be configurable-compatible.
rows.current_blocker: Planner/command coordinator model dimensions, but Safe Sync request is simple scalar product mutation and exposes no configurable option structure; public live remains false.

rows.requiredness: one or more children for useful configurable
rows.platform_domain_owner: Product to ProductVariant relation; ExternalRecordLink per entity
rows.current_blocker: Safe Sync has no relation read/write API; Receive is entity-bound name only; internal command coordinator is not publicly certified.

rows.product_type_applicability: simple; configurable pricing semantics depend on children/configuration
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: product save price; advanced/tier pricing use dedicated APIs
rows.platform_field_binding: resolved_price execution value, not editable Product field
rows.installation_condition: Website/base currency and product type affect meaning.
rows.current_blocker: Safe Sync read response omits price; Receive has no Pricing route implementation; live certification remains gated.

rows.write_endpoint_semantics: dedicated tier-price/advanced-pricing APIs; not one scalar overwrite
rows.platform_field_binding: no Product column; pricing domain records
rows.installation_condition: Customer group, website and quantity applicability are target data.
rows.current_blocker: Product aggregate and Safe Sync request carry one resolved scalar price only; no tier/special price semantic operation or Pricing Receive route.

rows.attribute_code: image / small_image / thumbnail roles reference media
rows.magento_api_datatype: array of media entry objects with content, types, label, position, disabled
rows.localization_semantics: labels/roles may be store scoped; binary identity is not translation
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: media create/update/delete APIs; binary/content and metadata lifecycle
rows.platform_domain_owner: Media (current products.images JSON; future first-class media)
rows.platform_field_binding: not a scalar FieldBinding for collection lifecycle
rows.installation_condition: Storage backend and store-view roles are target dependent.
rows.current_blocker: Preview/live has internal primary/gallery image operations, but Safe Sync deliberately makes product save media-neutral and exposes no media contract; first-class MediaAsset persistence is absent.

rows.magento_api_datatype: array of category link objects / ids
rows.localization_semantics: category labels localized separately; relation is not
rows.option_semantics: external category ids, not select options
rows.read_endpoint: product GET extension attributes; category product links APIs
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: category assignment/link APIs or extension attributes
rows.installation_condition: Target category tree and identifiers are installation dependent.
rows.current_blocker: No category relation discovery/mapping semantic operation exists in Adobe planner, Receive, or Safe Sync.

rows.version_applicability: Adobe Commerce 2.4.x with MSI; source/stock configuration dependent
rows.magento_api_datatype: source item records: sku, source_code, quantity, status
rows.value_cardinality: multi source records plus derived salability
rows.option_semantics: source and stock identities are relations
rows.product_type_applicability: sellable SKUs; configurable salability derives from children
rows.installation_condition: MSI sources/stocks and website assignments are installation dependent.
rows.current_blocker: V1 product semantic planner and Safe Sync module have no inventory read/write representation; a future operation must route through Availability, never Product columns.

rows.version_applicability: 2.4.x plus enabled modules; generated schema varies
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: module service contracts; never assume generic scalar custom_attribute semantics
rows.platform_domain_owner: Existing owning domain or connector configuration; classify before mapping
rows.installation_condition: Generated by enabled modules and target service contracts.
rows.current_blocker: Discovery only calls product EAV attribute metadata and cannot discover arbitrary extension schemas; no generic nested mapping/runtime exists and none should be invented without domain ownership.

rows.frontend_input: enumerated string but extensible by installed modules
rows.localization_semantics: scope=store currently normalized as localizable; labels/options require store-context provenance
rows.value_cardinality: options may be multi metadata collection
rows.option_semantics: options contain target values and labels
rows.write_endpoint_semantics: attribute administration is outside Product Sync V1
rows.installation_condition: Must be retrieved from each target/store context and reconciled with selected attribute set.
rows.current_blocker: Request factory hard-caps currentPage at 50 (10,000 rows) and assumes list schema/pagination; normalizer drops is_user_defined, is_visible, apply_to, backend_type, validation/default fields and treats store scope as the only localization signal.

rows.write_endpoint_semantics: not admitted by V1 product mapping
rows.installation_condition: Skip only when target returns null frontend_input, is_user_defined=false, is_visible=false and valid attribute_code.
rows.current_blocker: AdobePaaSServiceOnlyAttributeEligibility uses a narrow evidence-based conjunction; any other null frontend_input fails normalization. Expand only with official/target evidence, never blanket-skip.

gaps.expected: Core values are mapped with explicit mutation semantics.
gaps.actual: Preview represents sku/name/status/visibility; Receive is name-only; sku is identity-only in Safe Sync.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add separately governed candidates/allowlist entries only after per-field identity and scope rules are tested.
gaps.proof_test: Feature Receive proposal/apply tests plus Safe Sync reflection/logic tests; disposable target probe later.

gaps.expected: All verified scalar frontend inputs preserve requiredness, scope and write datatype.
gaps.actual: Normalizer maps a closed subset and Safe Sync coerces mapped values to string.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add verified input mappings and a typed mapped-value contract without permissive fallback.
gaps.proof_test: Normalizer fixtures per official input and Safe Sync reflection tests.

gaps.expected: Single and multiple options resolve target ids deterministically.
gaps.actual: Single select mapping works in preview; multiselect arrays are rejected and Safe Sync accepts one string.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add governed multi-option projection/serialization and complete-mapping validation.
gaps.proof_test: Planner tests for mapped multiselect, missing options, stable ordering, and target IDs.

gaps.expected: Parent dimensions, child links and per-child option values are readable and safely writable.
gaps.actual: Preview/internal commands model them; Safe Sync exposes neither relation reads nor writes.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add explicit entity-bound configurable read/write service contracts, not generic nested blobs.
gaps.proof_test: Module reflection + rollback/postcondition tests and later disposable Magento probe.

gaps.expected: Base and advanced prices route through Pricing with scope fidelity.
gaps.actual: Only one resolved base price reaches preview/Safe Sync write; no read or tiers.
gaps.smallest_correction: Keep base price explicit; design separate tier/advanced operation against existing Pricing owner.
gaps.proof_test: PriceResolver projection tests and website/currency disposable probe.

gaps.expected: Ordered gallery, roles and metadata have transactional read/write evidence.
gaps.actual: Internal media commands exist; Safe Sync product save intentionally bypasses media and has no media API.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add a separate entity-bound media contract with its own transaction/postconditions.
gaps.proof_test: Media-neutral regression plus isolated media rollback and target probe.

gaps.expected: External category relations map to workspace Category ownership.
gaps.actual: No relation discovery, mapping or operation exists.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add category relation input and connector-owned external category identity mapping without Product columns.
gaps.proof_test: Planner relation fixtures and category API disposable probe.

gaps.expected: MSI source/stock data routes through Availability.
gaps.actual: Product V1 and Safe Sync omit inventory entirely.
gaps.smallest_correction: Introduce a distinct Availability semantic operation only when scoped source/stock policy is approved.
gaps.proof_test: AvailabilityResolver integration tests plus MSI disposable read probe; no write in this audit.

gaps.expected: Each nested structure is classified to an existing owner.
gaps.actual: Discovery covers EAV metadata only and mapping is scalar-field oriented.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add explicit structure-specific discovery/planners, never a generic extension_attributes passthrough.
gaps.proof_test: Schema fixtures and dependency tests proving connector encapsulation.

gaps.expected: Mapped supported fields produce owner-routed proposals and governed apply commands.
gaps.actual: Adobe proposal constructs exactly one name candidate; Apply allowlist is intentionally narrow.
gaps.smallest_correction: Add candidates cluster-by-cluster and route dynamic, Pricing, Availability, Media and relations to their owners.
gaps.proof_test: Proposal unchanged/changed/unsupported/stale tests and per-owner apply tests.

gaps.expected: Entity-bound verification can expose fields required for Receive and postconditions.
gaps.actual: Response exposes identity and name only.
gaps.smallest_correction: Version the response with explicitly allowlisted scalar/structured reads and size bounds.
gaps.proof_test: Web API reflection and Magento module logic tests plus disposable read probe.

gaps.expected: Every admitted write has typed preconditions and postconditions.
gaps.actual: name/status/visibility/price and scalar mapped strings only; no sku, multi, media, relations, inventory or nested data.
gaps.smallest_correction: Extend one cluster at a time with fail-closed validation and exact postconditions.
gaps.proof_test: No-op, rollback, mismatch, ambiguous commit and postcondition tests per new cluster.

gaps.expected: Public support is true only after target evidence.
gaps.actual: Preview true; Products/Export/Live false despite internal command code.
gaps.smallest_correction: Do not change flags in this task; later require disposable target send/receive evidence and certification matrix.
gaps.proof_test: ModeAwareSyncSupportTest plus later recorded target probes.
